name: claude-session-switcher
description: Tabbed session switcher for Claude Code, IBM Bob, Codex and VS Code Chat — with traffic-light supervision of the actions your agents pause on

commands.title: Probe Bob Question — full approval state (debug)

claudeSessionSwitcher.autoRespond.markdownDescription:
Auto-respond rules for **Bob** and **Claude** sessions, evaluated in order (first match wins). Each rule is either a **text rule** `{ matchPattern, response }` (sends `response` when the latest assistant message matches the `matchPattern` regex) or an **approval rule** `{ toolPattern, decision }` (resolves a pending tool-approval prompt when `toolPattern` — a glob, `*` = any run of characters, `|` = alternatives — matches the tool name, optionally narrowed by an `argumentPattern` regex over the arguments JSON). Set `source` to `bob` (default) or `claude`. Add an optional `sessionPattern` (regex) to scope a rule to sessions whose project path matches.

A pending prompt that no rule handles is left for you — or handed to the supervisor when `reckon.autoSupervise` is on. A user-facing question (`ask_followup_question` / `AskUserQuestion`) is never auto-approved.

sessionPattern.description: Optional: JavaScript regex matched against the session's project path. When set, the rule applies only to sessions whose project path matches; omit to apply to all sessions.

matchPattern.description: Text rule: JavaScript regex tested against the latest assistant message.

response.description: Text rule: text sent into the session on a match.

toolPattern.description: Approval rule: glob matched against the pending tool name ('*' = any run of characters, '|' separates alternatives).

argumentPattern.description: Approval rule (optional): JavaScript regex matched against the pending tool arguments as JSON. Unanchored — matches anywhere in the JSON.

decision.description: Approval rule: how to resolve the prompt. approveForTask also suppresses future prompts for that permission group (and command, for execute_command).

source.description: Which IDE the rule applies to: 'bob' (default) or 'claude'.

reckon.uploadScriptPath.markdownDescription: **Deprecated** — the uploader is built in and needs no script. Kept only so an existing setting still works: when `reckon.dataRepoPath` is empty, the corpus repo root is derived from this path. Set `reckon.dataRepoPath` instead.
reckon.uploadScriptPath.deprecationMessage: The uploader now runs in-process. Set reckon.dataRepoPath to your corpus repo root instead.

claudeSessionSwitcher.probelessActiveWin.markdownDescription: How recently a **Codex** or **VS Code Chat** session must have been updated to count as active in the Sessions list. Those sources expose no live-process signal, so recency is the only available proxy; Claude and Bob sessions are judged by what their extension hosts actually report as open. Set to `0` to keep them in History always.

reckon.supervisorStateDir.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the supervision state directory. **Required to enable supervision.** Transcripts are exported to `<stateDir>/history/`, decisions are recorded in `<stateDir>/records/` (what the Supervision activity panel shows), and interventions queue in `<stateDir>/outbox/` until the agent confirms them.

Example: `/home/you/.ai-sessions/state`

reckon.autoSupervise.markdownDescription: When on, every agent prompt that no auto-approve rule handles is handed to the supervisor: the transcript is exported, the action is classified into a traffic light, and the decision is applied back into the agent. Requires `reckon.supervisorStateDir`.

reckon.supervisorRepoPath.markdownDescription: Workspace root the supervisor runs against — used to locate `.env` files and as the classifier's working directory. Derived from `reckon.supervisorStateDir` (its parent) when empty.

reckon.dataRepoPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to your corpus repository — the one containing `data/sessions/` (uploaded sessions) and `data/knowledge/` (the BDI tier files). Used by **Upload Session to Corpus** and, unless overridden, as the knowledge source for supervision.

reckon.knowledge.registryPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to a knowledge **registry** markdown file. When set, the `(user, project, team)` triple is validated against its tables and the documented fallbacks apply (a user on exactly one project may omit the project; an unknown slug is an error). When empty, the three slugs above are used as given. See `knowledge/REGISTRY.example.md`.

reckon.pythonPath.markdownDescription: **Deprecated and unused** — the supervisor is TypeScript and runs in-process. Reading IBM Bob's SQLite store still uses the `python3` on your PATH (see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`), but that path is not configurable through this setting.
reckon.pythonPath.deprecationMessage: Unused: the supervisor no longer runs a Python interpreter.
